text: For the postmortem: what time did I first report the kiosks offline on 3 Aug, and what was the guard doing in the meantime?
reply_text:
@gideon.sato: Your first report was 10:42 AM on 3 Aug, your message in #inc-vtg-hartford saying the gate kiosks were offline and both inbound lanes showed a white screen after badge scan. At that point the guard was writing trailer numbers on a clipboard.

The channel has no further guard observations before the fix. The next guard entry is Mateo's at 11:03 AM: kiosk 1 was back and the guard checked in trailer 8836, which dispatch could see. Both lanes were working by 11:07 AM, per your update.
